title: High CPU Usage
problem: Server CPU usage is unusually high
solution: Identify resource-intensive processes and investigate their workload

title: Disk Space Full
solution: Check disk usage and remove unnecessary temporary files

title: Network Connectivity Failure
problem: Application cannot connect to the network
solution: Check network connectivity and inspect relevant network configuration

title: Database Connection Error
problem: Application fails to connect to the database
solution: Verify database service status and check connection settings

title: Memory Exhaustion
solution: Inspect memory usage and investigate processes consuming excessive memory

title: Permission Denied
problem: User cannot access a required file or resource
solution: Verify user permissions and access control settings

title: Application Crash
solution: Inspect application logs and identify the error preceding the crash

title: Disk Read Error
problem: System reports disk read or storage errors
solution: Inspect storage health and review relevant system logs
